title: TCG:Legendary Saga
summary: Legendary Saga is the second card set of the Huntik Trading Card Game. Centering around the arc of the final nine episodes of Season 1, the set introduces the Ultra Rare Legendary Hero pile along with the Legendary Amulet Cards. The set also introduces two new groups of cards; the Bold Explorer Cards and the Sand Snakes.

full_text:
Legendary Saga is the second card set of the Huntik Trading Card Game. Centering around the arc of the final nine episodes of Season 1, the set introduces the Ultra Rare Legendary Hero pile along with the Legendary Amulet Cards. The set also introduces two new groups of cards; the Bold Explorer Cards and the Sand Snakes.

'''Legendary Saga''' is the second card set of the [[Huntik Trading Card Game]]. Centering around the arc of the final nine episodes of [[Season 1]], the set introduces the Ultra Rare Legendary Hero pile along with the Legendary Amulet Cards. The set also introduces two new groups of cards; the Bold Explorer Cards and the Sand Snakes. 

<center>
[[File:LGS Mission Map.jpg|250px]]
</center>
